name: Dangerous Truck Driving
desc:
Roads are dangerous, drive carefully! Reach the end if you can.

Be careful at down slopes and watch out for traffic. Oh, and don't drive too fast!

THE END: reach 43,000 studs

👍 Like and join the group for a free unstuck!

CONTROLS:

"H" - Honk 
"L" - Headlights
